notes.md: - **Flood-prone area (XII Plan):** The **Working Group on Flood Management and Region Specific Issues for the XII Plan (2011)** put the maximum area affected by floods in any year (1953–2010) at **49.815 million hectares**, up from the RBA's 40 million ha.

new.s: With the forests of which region is the Chipko movement associated?

new.angle: U0619 notes gap: Chipko -> Himalayas

new.s: According to the XII Plan Working Group on Flood Management (2011), what was the maximum area of India affected by floods in any year during 1953–2010?
new.x: The XII Plan Working Group put the maximum flood-affected area at 49.815 million ha, up from the 40 million ha of the Rashtriya Barh Ayog (1980).
new.angle: U0619 web: #17 flood-prone area -> XII Plan Working Group 49.815 mha

new.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Rashtriya Barh Ayog put India's flood-prone area at about 40 million hectares.
2. The XII Plan Working Group on Flood Management put the maximum flood-affected area at about 49.8 million hectares.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Both are correct: RBA (1980) gave about 40 million ha and the XII Plan Working Group (2011) gave 49.815 million ha.
new.angle: U0619 web: #17 flood-prone area assessments -> RBA vs XII Plan Working Group
